coverage-addition-3.scope: Three fresh guests, 256-byte request and 260-byte checked reply, eight FNV rounds, capacity 16, 5-s warmup and 30-s measurement, one outstanding request and 100-ms timeout. coverage-addition-4.scope: All six unchanged author test bodies at fixed 0b71b8e722ac; one complete independent reset, 500 internal iterations, native task/semaphore/timer and real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQ. coverage-addition-5.scope: All six unchanged author test bodies at fixed 0b71b8e722ac; one complete independent reset, 500 internal iterations, native task/semaphore/timer and real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQ. coverage-addition-6.scope: All six fixed author bodies, 500 iterations in iterative cases and one real peripheral IRQ; one independent reset is execution coverage, not a precision estimate or leaderboard input. RIOT native priority threads and tickless ztimer64 in 10-ms API units

coverage-addition-7.scope: All six fixed author bodies, 500 iterations in iterative cases and one real peripheral IRQ; one independent reset is execution coverage, not a precision estimate or leaderboard input. NuttX native task groups and SIGSTOP/SIGCONT with 100-Hz native tick

coverage-addition-8.scope: Three unchanged Thread-Metric core bodies, three fresh KVM guests each and one original 30-s window per guest. Native Tenon priority threads and semaphore; bounded FIFO copies four native unsigned-long words (32 B). Pi coverage only; not the ESP32 four-word/16-B ranking input.

coverage-addition-9.scope: Two unchanged original Thread-Metric IRQ bodies, three fresh KVM guests each, one 30-s window each. Hardware GICv2 SGI 1 via the native trap and registered dispatcher; ISACTIVER0 bit 1 witnesses an active interrupt before native EOI. Native IRQ nesting retained; original task/handler count invariants pass. Pi coverage only; no ESP32 ranking input.

coverage-addition-10.scope: Original Zephyr v3.7 synchronous TCP/UDP upload bodies, three independent resets per protocol, 60 s, 16384/1024-byte payloads and original receiver/wire accounting. Contiki process executes both uploaders with actual context checks; ESP-IDF 5.2.5/FreeRTOS provides hosting, sockets, clock and radio. Deployment coverage, not native Contiki TCP/IP.

coverage-addition-11.scope: Original Zephyr v3.7 synchronous TCP/UDP upload bodies, three independent resets per protocol, 60 s, 16384/1024-byte payloads and original receiver/wire accounting. RIOT native priority threads, POSIX/lwIP, 65536-byte network heap and tickless native clock with 10-ms statistic grid; separate matched native-select timeout control. UDP maps blocking send to repeated native send calls only on transient buffer exhaustion, with a 2-s per-call guard and explicit wait accounting included in the original duration. TCP keeps its previously acquired firmware and one prior sample; UDP uses its separately bound adapter image. This is adapter-inclusive execution coverage, not an unmodified native-API performance score.

coverage-addition-12.scope: Unchanged Zephyr 3.7 synchronous TCP/UDP upload cores, 3 fresh one-vCPU Pi4B KVM guests/protocol, 60 s, 16384/1024-byte payloads. Native Tenon workload and clock; Linux host sockets over declared PL011 bridge, all bridge overhead included. Real LAN receiver and UDP packet/finish/statistics replay. Deployment execution coverage, not native Tenon TCP/IP or B1 scores.

coverage-addition-13.scope: All 24 unchanged Zephyr v3.7.0 kernel-mode semaphore tests pass in one complete B1 reset; 28 real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQs. Native FreeRTOS counting semaphores, priority/FIFO waits and ISR operations; reset uses native abort-delay, byte pipe uses native queues plus writer mutex, actual worker stacks 4096 B. Native conditions 240 MHz, one core, 100 Hz; no skipped kernel-mode case. Adapter-inclusive correctness coverage, not a precision estimate, Zephyr userspace or leaderboard score.

coverage-addition-14.scope: All 24 unchanged Zephyr v3.7.0 kernel-mode semaphore tests pass in one complete B1 reset; 28 real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQs. Native RIOT semaphores, mutex priority waiters, native deadlines and IRQ-safe operations; reset cancels retired native instances with sema_destroy, bounded byte pipe uses native semaphore notifications. Actual worker stacks 4096 B, 240 MHz, one core; tickless native ztimer; no skipped kernel-mode case. Adapter-inclusive correctness coverage, not a precision estimate, Zephyr userspace or leaderboard score.

coverage-addition-15.scope: All 24 unchanged Zephyr v3.7.0 kernel-mode semaphore tests pass in one complete B1 reset; 28 real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQs. Native NuttX task groups and priority semaphore waits, native deadlines and IRQ-safe try/post; reset releases retired native semaphore instances with native posts, bounded byte pipe uses native semaphores. Actual worker stacks 4096 B, 240 MHz, one core; 100 Hz; no skipped kernel-mode case. Adapter-inclusive correctness coverage, not a precision estimate, Zephyr userspace or leaderboard score.

coverage-addition-16.scope: All 24 unchanged Zephyr v3.7.0 kernel-mode semaphore tests pass in one complete B1 reset; 28 real CPU_FROM_CPU2 IRQs. Native Rhino priority tasks and semaphores, native sleep and reset cancellation by retiring deleted static objects. Public take rejects ISR context; the no-wait compatibility operation reads/decrements the native object count under CPU IRQ lock, without faking interrupt context. Byte pipe uses native semaphore notifications. Actual worker stacks 4096 B, 240 MHz, one core; 100 Hz; no skipped kernel-mode case. Adapter-inclusive correctness coverage, not a precision estimate, Zephyr userspace or leaderboard score.

coverage-addition-17.scope: 24 unchanged Zephyr 3.7.0 kernel-mode cases, one complete one-vCPU 128-MiB Pi4B KVM guest, 28 real GICv2 SGIs. Native Tenon priority tasks, semaphore waits and timers. Explicit isolated-kernel compatibility fixes cancel the timeout on ISR wake and avoid duplicate wake-all transitions; original scheduler assertions and failed v1-v4 remain. Retired native objects map reset cancellation; byte pipe uses native semaphores, workers 16384 B. Correctness execution coverage of this fixed variant, not unmodified upstream capability, RAM/latency or B1 scores.

coverage-addition-18.scope: One complete B1 reset of PH3 on five native Contiki processes/etimers, unchanged SEI-derived C Small_Whetstone and PH3 release/step rules; full first-loss termination. Hosted by ESP-IDF/FreeRTOS at 240 MHz, one core, 1-ms event timers; completion clock is quantized to 10 us. Cooperative event dispatch, no preemptive-priority emulation; this is measured workload coverage, not a pooled preemptive PH3 capacity or B1 Overall input. First loss at step 0.

coverage-addition-19.scope: One complete native Tenon Pi4B one-vCPU 128-MiB KVM PH3 guest; unchanged SEI-derived C workload and contiguous 10-second PH3 steps to first loss.
